summary: Full candidate gate at fork head 3c73a59743e3dfe4b5ae5e11b0cdbe8c1e8fcae6 (re-verified live at filing; clean clone; seed 17764C0DE throughout). FAILED on the repetition leg only: ProbeGracefulRejectionClientTest passed 14/14 in runs 1, 2, 5, and 6 but FAILED in runs 3 and 4, both times in the same method, testForgedMarkerOnApplication503AuthorizesRetry, with the same transport signature (SolrServerException wrapping java.io.IOException: HTTP/1.1 header parser received no bytes, i.e., the connection closed with no response bytes; no assertion about retry behavior was reached). That is a repeatable-at-rate instability of roughly one run in three, confined to that method; the client production code is identical to the r3-diagnostic head, where three runs happened to pass, so the instability predates this head and was under-sampled there. Per requirement 7 the gate cannot be passed while a required leg fails. EVERYTHING ELSE IS GREEN at this head: the primary solrj suite passed (CloudSolrClientCacheTest 13/13 including the six pre-existing 503 methods, CloudHttp2SolrClientRetryTest 1/1, CloudSolrClientRoutingTest 2/2, probe class 14/14); ProbeGracefulRejectionJettyBodyCloseTest 1/1; ProbeGracefulMultiShardTest 1/1 and TestGracefulJettyShutdown 1/1 with -Ptests.nightly=true; tidy zero changes; ROOT CHECK -x test PASSED (the validateLogCalls repair holds). MUTATION (requirement 4): in a disposable checkout, testMixedRouteFailureDoesNotReplayMarkedRejection passes unmutated and fails with only the outer whole-batch guard removed and the inner marked guard intact ('Expected exception RouteException but no exception was thrown'); the diff is preserved and the checkout was restored clean. PACKAGED (requirement 3), installDist with a real collection (Collections API create, select verified 200): with the default start, the stop completed in 2.4 s and fresh-connection polls during the window received zero HTTP responses (81 connection failures, no 503, no marker); with SOLR_JETTY_GRACEFUL=true set before startup, the stop window lasted 6.5 s with uploads in flight and a request on an existing keep-alive connection received HTTP 503 with header X-Solr-Graceful-Shutdown: rejected 0.57 s after the stop was issued (19:16:14.632 UTC), while fresh connections were still refused throughout. The forged-marker acceptance under enabled trust is by design; the receipt records the standing prerequisite that the operator controls all intermediaries, since the marker carries no provenance. GAPS recorded per requirements 1, 2, and 6: no separate deterministic callback-ordering test was constructed beyond the class's own async methods; several matrix cells (nested iterators, custom writers, materialized updates) are covered only by the classes as written and were not independently re-derived at this head; the six original reviewed-head fail-before regressions rest on prior-head evidence, restated by the r2/r3 lineage, not re-executed here. Two stale XML files dated 2026-11-10 were found in the local runs directory from an earlier session, identified by timestamp, excluded from this gate's evidence, and are named here so they are not mistaken for r4 results.
